name: Apollo 11 Landing Site

locations.label: Eagle LM Descent Stage, Mare Tranquillitatis

summary: Apollo 11 was the first crewed mission to touch down on the Moon.
hook: I carried humanity to the lunar surface and my descent stage still stands in Tranquility Base.
how_it_worked: The Eagle descent stage used a throttleable descent engine and four landing pads to achieve the first powered lunar landing.
science: Astronauts collected 21.5 kilograms of lunar rocks and deployed early passive seismometers.

facts.text: The descent stage served as the launch pad when the ascent stage lifted off to rejoin orbit.
Laser pulses from Earth are still reflected off mirror prisms placed at the site.

image.alt: Apollo 11 Lunar Module Eagle resting on the lunar surface at Tranquility Base, with Buzz Aldrin preparing to deploy experiments
